propositions: Codex lacks a project-scoped Serena MCP server entry, preventing semantic navigation for contributors who rely on Pyright-based symbol resolution.
The project requires a tracked, repo-scoped MCP configuration in .codex/config.toml that automatically activates for all trusted worktrees without mutating operator-local global config.
Serena must be pinned to a specific verified upstream commit and launched with --context codex and --project-from-cwd to enable per-checkout activation.
The Serena server entry must have a 120-second startup timeout to accommodate cold uvx resolution and must remain non-required so startup failure does not block Codex operation.
Configuration must be validated to ensure TOML parsability, correct command invocation, MCP protocol compliance, and isolation from untrusted directories.
